hypothesis: For independently existing same-wallet binary outcome inventory with known all-in acquisition basis, an actual later opposite-outcome taker buy at exact matched quantity creates a direction-independent complete set. Count a lock only when the first-leg basis plus the later hedge price stressed one adverse tick plus the full current crypto taker fee remains strictly below one pUSD.

distinctness.not_the_rejected_strategy: The retained 2026-08-25 wallet day had negative aggregate naive FIFO pairing. This contract never initiates first-leg inventory, never assumes both legs fill atomically, and never credits a negative completion.
distinctness.relation_to_existing_rank_17: The existing maker-first candidate starts with a new passive maker order and requires a synchronized creation-time hedge. This candidate instead starts only from independently existing public-wallet taker inventory and asks whether a later actual opposite taker fill locked a complete set under a causal fixed rule.
distinctness.relation_to_existing_rank_23: The prior Round 27 rescore tested standalone both-taker complete-set entry under tier rebates. This contract credits no rebate, starts from preexisting inventory, stresses only the later risk-reducing hedge, and cannot justify the first-leg strategy.

These values selected the hypothesis and are not validation evidence.

wallet_selection: Fixed before validation from the prior completed August 25 public top-volume taker-rebate reconciliation. The wallet is public evidence, not owned, authorized, or assumed reproducible.

validation_window.selection_rule: One complete later UTC day fixed before access, five days after the training day and before the current partial UTC day.

endpoint_classification.operation: download one public unauthenticated window of already executed taker trades for one public wallet
endpoint_classification.security: public unauthenticated read-only Data API GET
endpoint_classification.preflight: The exact query shape is source-bound by the retained official trades contract and the prior completed request. No validation-window preflight was made.

economics.inventory_origin: Only BUY rows acquired earlier inside the same validation window and same condition. Start every condition at zero; exclude any condition containing a SELL row.
economics.matching_rule: Chronological actual taker BUY rows. At each later BUY, scan still-unmatched opposite lots in acquisition order and match only exact available quantity whose first-leg full-fee cost plus later hedge price stressed one 0.01 tick and charged the full 0.07 fee is strictly below one. Expire first-leg lots after 60 seconds. Same-second ordering is excluded.
economics.cashflow_identity: Each matched YES plus NO share is a mergeable or terminal one-pUSD complete set. Locked PnL equals matched quantity times one minus first-leg all-in cost minus stressed later-hedge all-in cost.
economics.cost_conservatism: Credit no taker rebate, no maker rebate, no liquidity reward, no holding yield, no midpoint, no future price movement, and no public-wallet PnL. The official relayer split or merge gas identity is retained only as zero direct user gas, not as authority or latency proof.

decision.passing_result: Create a source-bound historical out-of-sample candidate for an existing-inventory opposite-leg lock overlay. Keep accepted-edge count unchanged, public forward floor zero, and require a separately frozen current prospective public book study followed by explicit account and order authority before any owned execution question.
decision.failing_result: Terminalize this exact wallet and validation day without retry, narrowing, pagination, alternate matching, rebate credit, or another wallet selection.

source_bindings.role: prior public wallet selection exact trade endpoint contract fee formula and realized rebate reconciliation
distinct maker-first mechanism boundary and complete-set payoff identity

retry_policy: The exact wallet and August 30 UTC window GET is one-use. Preserve an empty, full-page, malformed, failed, or negative result without retrying, splitting, paginating, changing the wallet, adding rebates, relaxing lag or concentration gates, or selecting another day after seeing the result.
